reviewType: AI semantic review; not human-expert ground truth
primaryScope: Every exact definition, membership set and selected sense inspected before fitting; corrections to motion/condition, private feelings, roles, objects versus settings, and accidental synonym leakage.
dispositions: Accepted structure labels consistent with the frozen tower/bridge policy, retaining multiple independent routes.
Accepted noun/adjective/role/opposite and near-paraphrase grouping recommendations.
Kept the ordinary word uncertainty as a valid private condition; it is distinct from a classifier uncertainty/fallback output.
Added entity to explicit person-role referents alongside relation and abstract; isolated people do not establish their roles.
Kept coaxial distinct from concentric and coplanar distinct from parallel; sharing a general geometry domain is not identity of selected meaning.
Linked purpose/back-to-back with related old test families; these cannot enter train or the fresh evaluation sets.
Corrected secondary reviewer stale IDs/content claims by inspecting the final primary data; only valid recommendations adopted.
limitations: AI authorship and review can share biases; agreement is not independent expert truth.
Class balance refers to training membership counts, not proof of deployment frequency or semantic certainty.
1000 text examples include related meanings; family grouping prevents counting paraphrases as independent evaluation samples.
